duration.text: The Biomedical engineering at Shandong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number & expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant3.Bachelor's degree diplomaGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of undergraduate school5. A copy of the Physical Examination Record for Foreigners6.English proficiency test certificateFor example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.7. requirements.text: 1. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport with good health.2. Applicants should own bachelor degree in concerned subjects or above.
